name: Big Apple Comic Con
blurb: A one-day comic convention at the Wyndham New Yorker Hotel focused on classic comic book writers, artists and collectibles.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'SATURDAY, NOVEMBER 21, 2026 HOLIDAY CON'; footer: 'Wyndham New Yorker Hotel 481 8th Ave, New York, NY 10001'; schedule page repeats 'BACC HOLIDAY CON NOVEMBER 21, 2026'.

notes: Only one event in the research window is listed on the site, the November 21, 2026 one-day 'BACC Holiday Con'; no separate spring/summer show was found, which is likely what the seed note's 'also holds a December edition' refers to (this year's edition is simply dated to November instead of December). Refute pass (2026-10-05): a fresh re-extraction (saved as -v2, same 17 candidates/order) shows only 5 of the 17 picked cards -- Bob Sharen, Dan Fogel, Jasper Kuther, Kyle Willis, Mike DeCarlo -- have images uploaded in wp-content/uploads/2026/09/ (Dan Fogel's file is even named 'BACC-2026-Guest-Dan-Fogel'), i.e. added after the prior Nov 22, 2025 Holiday Con; the other 12 (Dorman, Steranko, Lieber, Martinez, Chu, Kong, Igle, Williams, Gudsnuk, Hama, Welz, Virella) are images uploaded 2022-2025, and a web search for the actual Nov 22, 2025 show's guests independently confirms Steranko, Lieber, Chu and Williams already appeared at that prior edition -- so this is last year's grid with 5 new names layered in, not a freshly announced 2026 lineup; trimmed to the 5 with dated proof, the rest removed for lack of per-guest evidence tying them to the Nov 21, 2026 show specifically.
